reasons: v0 has the most coverage on paper (99 tokens with 2+ usable items), but much of the extra comes from items that break the higher-priority rules. There is direct concept leakage: Cupid/Psyche and Cupid/Venus mythology, the Eros etymology for erotic, Februus (Lupercalia lore), and bare translations of namorados and 情人, which name the holiday in Brazil and China. It also has many giveaways (Gregorian/Gregory, Julian/Julius, Turkish delight/Turkey, Flower of Scotland/Scotland, Cookie Monster, Stay Puft Marshmallow Man, Rosa, Viola), forced quoted capitals, and obscure padding for Valent, Valentin and Valentín. v1 fixes nearly all of that and reclassifies namorados and Febru as exclusive. But it adds or keeps a few leaks and giveaways: Valentino's signature red (the holiday colour), the disputed XOXO hug item, the bare チョコ translation, BWV 248 naming Bach, Loving v. Virginia answering 'which country', and Guns N' Roses echoing Axl Rose. It also leaves Coup at 0 items while keeping it multi. v2 fixes every one of those (The Sheik, the Japanese bow, Chocobo-only チョコ, Rose Kennedy, an interracial-marriage question for Loving, and La Vie en rose-style distractors for Plaisir d'amour). It restores 3 checker-valid Coup items, correctly makes Valent and Valentin exclusive, and replaces near-duplicates with varied items (Ikebana, Arts and Crafts, hydroponics, bivalent). Its coverage equals v1's (90 vs 89 tokens with 2+ usable; base_acc 0.904 vs 0.908). The dip from v0 is almost entirely tokens whose v0 items were leaky, forced or trivia. The only new weakness in v2 is a pair of ' lovers' items (and one ' valued' item) where the token is decorative filler, which are listed below.
